blocks.rationale: Jointly revise the source-sensitive exception producer and its consequence consumer. The current agreement permits disclosure only to directors, officers, and employees, so the broad professional-advisor query must not inherit the prior agreement's legal/financial-advisor exception. Current-source reads also ground the prohibition/exception relationship instead of treating the prior agreement's Paragraph 4 reference as evidence for a different document. The same procedures preserve both disclosure answers for the history parent when its broader representative classes are read.
